---
title: WorkingDoc - manually edit gating
format: html
---

This document will walk you through manually adjusting gates if needed after the automatic clean up gates are applied.
It is best to run the cells one at a time.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(flowGate)
output_folder_contents <- list.dirs(output_folder, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
PT_gatingSets <- output_folder_contents[str_detect(
  output_folder_contents,
  pattern = "PT_GatingSet"
)]

PT_gs <- load_gs(PT_gatingSets)
```

## flowGate

Adjust gates through gatingSet

```{r}
#| label: view gates
plot(PT_gs) # check gate names in gatingSet

gate_to_be_adjusted <- "singlets" # change to gate to adjust. case sensitive.
```

```{r}
#| label: Adjust gates in Shiny App
gs_apply_gate_check(
  gs = PT_gs,
  gate = gate_to_be_adjusted,
  AdjustAll = FALSE # set to TRUE if you want to new gate location to apply to all samples
)
```


```{r}
#| label: Check all gates on samples again

Adjusted_Gates <- Utility_GatingPlots(
  PT_gs,
  sample.name = "TUBENAME",
  gtFile = cleanup_gates,
  returnType = "patchwork",
  removestrings = ".fcs"
)
Adjusted_Gates
```

If unhappy with placement or another gate needs to be adjusted, go back to the top. 

```{r}
#| label: Check NxN 

NxN_adjusted_gates <- Utility_NbyNPlots(
  PT_gs,
  sample.name = "TUBENAME",
  gatesubset = "singlets",
  ycolumn = "SSC-A"
)

NxN_adjusted_gates
```


```{r}
#| label: save gs again

GatingSetTimestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
PT_gs_save_path <- file.path(
  output_folder,
  paste0("PT_GatingSet_Adjusted", "_", GatingSetTimestamp)
)
save_gs(PT_gs, path = PT_gs_save_path)

```
